title: Bottleneck Strata Simulation
description:
Data and code of the simulation study in Marek Deja, Bottleneck strata for bounds on probabilities of causation from combined experimental and observational data (manuscript). The study answers six questions fixed in a protocol before the run: the validity of the population bounds of stratifiers learned from a sample, the width of the bounds and the component of a stratifier that carries the narrowing, the behavior of the estimated bounds and of the intervals in finite samples, the information bound on the width lost by compression, the two-group specification of the multivariate bottleneck, and latent profiles with effects of both signs.

Contents: the protocol (version 2), the two scripts that produce the result tables, the result tables of the three experiments and of the six questions, and ibstrata 0.2.0, the Python package that implements the method, with its tests. Version 2.0.0 keeps the simulated populations, the seeds and the stratifiers of version 1.0.0 and adds six stratifiers, the estimate with binding terms selected out of fold and its interval, the coverage of the intervals at the ends of the identified set, population bounds on PN and PS, the narrowest bounds of two, three and four strata, and a third experiment.
